lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: Two hundred and eighty-one years. I published, I was ruined for it inside eleven months, and there has been a public terminal at the foot of this thing ever since, which anybody may use, and which several people are using right now without looking up.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I do not remember doing it. I remember losing the vote seven to two. I also remember a version of me who did not lose. Both are in my head at once and I have made my peace with which one is standing here, mostly.
